reviews.reason: BRepGProp's default integration on the faces bounded by the Boolean's intersection edges (the sphere and the spline wall) misses the reference by 3.2e-06 in volume (1.00378232 against 1.00378556), 1.9e-06 in area and 1.6e-07 of the size in the centre. The result is valid with the reference's solid count.
